title: Use uploaded images as hard character references and explicitly lock each image…
content:
Use uploaded images as hard character references and explicitly lock each image to a specific fighter to prevent face/wardrobe/silhouette drift and role swapping.

Add a CHARACTER LOCK section that instructs Seedance to preserve exact face, hair, build, shorts, gloves, and silhouette, and to forbid swapping fighters or adding extras.

Add a SPACE LOCK section that fixes each fighter’s starting position and stance, and instructs the model to keep ropes/corners/center mark and left-right relationship consistent while showing every position change.

Specify the lighting and environment details (hard overhead arena lights, dark audience beyond ropes, sweat on canvas, taut ropes, corner posts) to stabilize the scene setting.

Constrain motion realism with explicit COMBAT RULES (realistic guard/distance/footwork/weight transfer/contact/recovery; visible setup for every strike; return to guard; no impossible combinations).

Use a DRAMATIC ENGINE: Combat directive plus SCENE TURN (who gains control by what decisive action) to force a coherent fight arc.

Control edits with CUT LOGIC: only cut on contact or when a position change requires a clearer angle; otherwise keep continuous action.

Storyboard the generation with timestamped beats (e.g., 0.0–3.0 pressure, 3.0–6.0 first attack, 6.0–9.5 counter, 9.5–12.5 reversal, 12.5–15.0 finish) and define camera + action for each segment.

For each beat, specify camera shot scale, angle, physical position, and movement (and whether the cut is continuous or motivated) to guide cinematography.

Add an AUDIO section (no music; gloves/body impacts, feet sliding on canvas, breathing, rope tension, corner reactions, distant crowd) to steer sound design.

Include a NEGATIVE CONTROL block banning common failure modes (random attacks, floating footwork, missed contact shown as impact, teleporting, unstepped stance switches, crossed screen direction, role swap, face morphing, extra fighters, comedy, subtitles, logos, UI).

es.content:
Usa las imágenes subidas como referencias rígidas de los personajes y bloquea explícitamente cada imagen a un luchador específico para evitar que se desvíen el rostro, la vestimenta o la silueta, y para impedir el intercambio de roles.

Añade una sección CHARACTER LOCK que indique a Seedance que preserve exactamente el rostro, el cabello, la complexión, los shorts, los guantes y la silueta, y que prohíba intercambiar luchadores o añadir extras.

Añade una sección SPACE LOCK que fije la posición inicial y la postura de cada luchador, e indique al modelo que mantenga coherentes las cuerdas, las esquinas, la marca central y la relación izquierda-derecha, mostrando cada cambio de posición.

Especifica los detalles de iluminación y entorno (luces duras cenitales del arena, público oscuro más allá de las cuerdas, sudor sobre el canvas, cuerdas tensas, postes de esquina) para estabilizar la ambientación.

Restringe el realismo del movimiento con COMBAT RULES explícitas (guardia/distancia/footwork/transferencia de peso/contacto/recuperación realistas; preparación visible para cada golpe; regreso a la guardia; sin combinaciones imposibles).

Usa un DRAMATIC ENGINE: directiva de combate más SCENE TURN (quién toma el control y mediante qué acción decisiva) para forzar un arco de pelea coherente.

Controla las ediciones con CUT LOGIC: corta solo en el contacto o cuando un cambio de posición requiera un ángulo más claro; de lo contrario, mantén la acción continua.

Estructura la generación con beats con marca temporal (p. ej., 0.0–3.0 presión, 3.0–6.0 primer ataque, 6.0–9.5 contraataque, 9.5–12.5 reversión, 12.5–15.0 final) y define cámara + acción para cada segmento.

Para cada beat, especifica la escala del plano de cámara, el ángulo, la posición física y el movimiento (y si el corte es continuo o motivado) para guiar la cinematografía.

Añade una sección AUDIO (sin música; impactos de guantes/cuerpo, pies deslizándose sobre el canvas, respiración, tensión de las cuerdas, reacciones en la esquina, público lejano) para orientar el diseño sonoro.

Incluye un bloque NEGATIVE CONTROL que prohíba modos de fallo comunes (ataques aleatorios, footwork flotante, mostrar un impacto cuando el contacto falla, teletransporte, cambios de postura sin pasos visibles, dirección de pantalla cruzada, intercambio de roles, morphing del rostro, luchadores extra, comedia, subtítulos, logos, UI).

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Plantilla de prompt

[FORMATO / INICIO]
Genera una pelea cinematográfica live-action de Muay Thai de [duración] [relación de aspecto]. La acción comienza de inmediato. Usa las imágenes subidas como referencias rígidas de los personajes.

[CHARACTER LOCK]
La imagen A es Fighter A. Preserva exactamente el rostro, el cabello, la complexión, los shorts, los guantes y la silueta.
La imagen B es Fighter B. Preserva exactamente el rostro, el cabello, la complexión, los shorts, los guantes y la silueta.
No intercambies a los luchadores. No hay extras dentro del ring.

[SPACE LOCK]
Fighter A comienza [posición] en [postura].
Fighter B comienza [posición] en [postura].
Mantén coherentes las cuerdas, las esquinas, la marca central y la relación izquierda-derecha. Muestra cada cambio de posición.

[SETTING]
Ring profesional de Muay Thai bajo luces duras cenitales del arena. Público oscuro más allá de las cuerdas. Sudor en el canvas, postes de esquina y cuerdas tensas.

[COMBAT RULES]
Usa guardia, distancia, footwork, transferencia de peso, contacto y recuperación realistas. Cada golpe tiene una preparación visible. Cada defensa crea la siguiente apertura. Los luchadores vuelven a la guardia después del contacto. Sin combinaciones imposibles.

DRAMATIC ENGINE: Combat
SCENE TURN: [Fighter] toma el control mediante [acción decisiva].
CUT LOGIC: Corta solo cuando el contacto o un cambio de posición requiera un ángulo más claro.

[0.0–3.0 — PRESSURE]

Camera: [escala del plano, ángulo, posición física, movimiento].

Action: Fighter A [avanza/circula/cierra el ring]. Fighter B observa el pecho de A, ajusta la guardia y retrocede hacia [cuerdas/esquina].

[3.0–6.0 — FIRST ATTACK]

Camera: [corte continuo o motivado].

Action: Fighter A planta [pie] y lanza [golpe]. Fighter B [bloquea/checkea/desvía], absorbe el contacto y se desplaza a [nueva posición].

[6.0–9.5 — COUNTER]

Camera: [escala del plano y ángulo de colisión].

Action: Fighter B lee la apertura, entra [por dentro/por fuera] y contraataca con [golpe]. La cabeza o el cuerpo de Fighter A reaccionan al contacto antes de que la guardia se recupere.

[9.5–12.5 — REVERSAL]

Camera: [corte continuo o motivado].

Action: Fighter A recupera el equilibrio, mira a los ojos a B y [gira/cierra la distancia/entra en el clinch]. B se prepara y lucha por la posición.

[12.5–15.0 — FINISH]

Camera: [ángulo final claro]. Mantén la toma durante el impacto.

Action: [Fighter] controla [cabeza/brazo/posición en el ring], crea espacio y conecta [golpe final]. El oponente cae contra [cuerdas/canvas] mientras el ganador restablece la guardia y lo observa.

[AUDIO]
Sin música. Golpes de guantes contra la guardia y el cuerpo, pies descalzos deslizándose sobre el canvas, respiración controlada, tensión de las cuerdas, reacciones en la esquina y ruido lejano del público.

[NEGATIVE CONTROL]
Sin ataques aleatorios, sin footwork flotante, sin mostrar un impacto cuando el contacto falla, sin teletransporte, sin cambios de postura sin pasos visibles, sin dirección de pantalla cruzada, sin intercambio de roles, sin morphing del rostro, sin luchadores extra, sin comedia, sin subtítulos, sin logos, sin UI.

fr.content:
Utilisez les images téléchargées comme références de personnage strictes et verrouillez explicitement chaque image à un combattant spécifique afin d’éviter toute dérive du visage, des vêtements ou de la silhouette, ainsi que tout échange de rôles.

Ajoutez une section CHARACTER LOCK qui demande à Seedance de préserver exactement le visage, les cheveux, la corpulence, le short, les gants et la silhouette, et d’interdire tout échange de combattants ou l’ajout de figurants.

Ajoutez une section SPACE LOCK qui fixe la position de départ et la garde de chaque combattant, et demande au modèle de conserver de manière cohérente les cordes, les coins, le repère central et la relation gauche-droite, tout en montrant chaque changement de position.

Précisez les détails d’éclairage et d’environnement (lumières dures au plafond de l’arène, public sombre au-delà des cordes, sueur sur la toile, cordes tendues, poteaux de coin) afin de stabiliser le décor.

Encadrez le réalisme du mouvement avec des COMBAT RULES explicites (garde réaliste, distance, footwork, transfert de poids, contact, récupération ; préparation visible pour chaque frappe ; retour en garde ; aucune combinaison impossible).

Utilisez un DRAMATIC ENGINE : directive de combat plus SCENE TURN (qui prend le contrôle et par quelle action décisive) pour imposer une trajectoire de combat cohérente.

Contrôlez les edits avec CUT LOGIC : ne coupez qu’au moment du contact ou lorsqu’un changement de position exige un angle plus clair ; sinon, conservez une action continue.

Structurez la génération avec des beats horodatés (par ex. 0.0–3.0 pression, 3.0–6.0 première attaque, 6.0–9.5 contre, 9.5–12.5 renversement, 12.5–15.0 finish) et définissez la caméra + l’action pour chaque segment.

Pour chaque beat, précisez l’échelle du plan, l’angle, la position physique et le mouvement de caméra (et si le cut est continu ou motivé) afin de guider la cinématographie.

Ajoutez une section AUDIO (pas de musique ; impacts des gants/corps, pieds glissant sur la toile, respiration, tension des cordes, réactions du coin, bruit lointain de la foule) pour orienter la conception sonore.

Incluez un bloc NEGATIVE CONTROL interdisant les modes d’échec courants (attaques aléatoires, footwork flottant, contact manqué présenté comme un impact, téléportation, changements de garde sans pas visibles, direction d’écran croisée, échange de rôles, morphing du visage, combattants supplémentaires, comédie, sous-titres, logos, UI).

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---
[Thread 1] Modèle de prompt

[FORMAT / START]
Générez un combat de Muay Thai cinématographique en live-action de [duration] [aspect ratio]. L’action commence immédiatement. Utilisez les images téléchargées comme références de personnage strictes.

[CHARACTER LOCK]
L’image A est Fighter A. Préservez exactement le visage, les cheveux, la corpulence, le short, les gants et la silhouette.
L’image B est Fighter B. Préservez exactement le visage, les cheveux, la corpulence, le short, les gants et la silhouette.
Ne permutez pas les combattants. Aucun figurant dans le ring.

[SPACE LOCK]
Fighter A commence [position] en [stance].
Fighter B commence [position] en [stance].
Conservez de manière cohérente les cordes, les coins, le repère central et la relation gauche-droite. Montrez chaque changement de position.

[SETTING]
Ring professionnel de Muay Thai sous des lumières dures au plafond de l’arène. Public sombre au-delà des cordes. Toile marquée par la sueur, poteaux de coin et cordes tendues.

[COMBAT RULES]
Utilisez une garde, une distance, un footwork, un transfert de poids, un contact et une récupération réalistes. Chaque frappe a une préparation visible. Chaque défense crée la prochaine ouverture. Les combattants reviennent en garde après le contact. Aucune combinaison impossible.

DRAMATIC ENGINE: Combat
SCENE TURN: [Fighter] prend le contrôle par [decisive action].
CUT LOGIC: Ne coupez que lors du contact ou lorsqu’un changement de position exige un angle plus clair.

[0.0–3.0 — PRESSURE]

Camera: [shot scale, angle, physical position, movement].

Action: Fighter A [advances/circles/cuts off the ring]. Fighter B observe le torse de A, ajuste sa garde et recule vers [ropes/corner].

[3.0–6.0 — FIRST ATTACK]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A plante [foot] et lance [strike]. Fighter B [blocks/checks/parries], absorbe le contact et se déplace vers [new position].

[6.0–9.5 — COUNTER]

Camera: [shot scale and collision angle].

Action: Fighter B lit l’ouverture, entre [inside/outside], et contre avec [strike]. La tête ou le corps de Fighter A réagit au contact avant que la garde ne se rétablisse.

[9.5–12.5 — REVERSAL]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A retrouve son équilibre, croise le regard de B, et [pivots/closes distance/enters the clinch]. B se brace et se bat pour la position.

[12.5–15.0 — FINISH]

Camera: [clear final angle]. Hold through the impact.

Action: [Fighter] contrôle [head/arm/ring position], crée de l’espace et place [finishing strike]. L’adversaire heurte [ropes/canvas] tandis que le vainqueur remet sa garde en place et le regarde.

[AUDIO]
Pas de musique. Gants frappant la garde et le corps, pieds nus glissant sur la toile, respiration contrôlée, tension des cordes, réactions du coin et bruit lointain de la foule.

[NEGATIVE CONTROL]
Pas d’attaques aléatoires, pas de footwork flottant, pas de contact manqué présenté comme un impact, pas de téléportation, pas de changement de garde sans pas visibles, pas de direction d’écran croisée, pas d’échange de rôles, pas de morphing du visage, pas de combattants supplémentaires, pas de comédie, pas de sous-titres, pas de logos, pas d’UI.

ja.content:
アップロードされた画像を、キャラクターのハードリファレンスとして使用し、各画像を特定のファイターに明示的に固定して、顔・衣装・シルエットのドリフトや役割の入れ替わりを防ぐ。

CHARACTER LOCK セクションを追加し、Seedance に対して正確な顔、髪型、体格、ショーツ、グローブ、シルエットを保持するよう指示し、ファイターの入れ替えや追加キャラクターの挿入を禁止する。

SPACE LOCK セクションを追加し、各ファイターの開始位置と構えを固定し、ロープ／コーナー／センターマークおよび左右関係を一貫して保ちながら、すべての位置変化を見せるようモデルに指示する。

照明と環境の詳細（強い上方からのアリーナ照明、ロープの向こう側にある暗い観客席、キャンバス上の汗、張ったロープ、コーナーポスト）を指定して、シーン設定を安定させる。

明示的な COMBAT RULES（現実的なガード／距離／フットワーク／体重移動／接触／リカバリー、各打撃の見える準備動作、ガードへの復帰、不可能なコンビネーションの禁止）で動きのリアリズムを制約する。

DRAMATIC ENGINE を使う：Combat directive に加え、SCENE TURN（誰がどの決定的なアクションで主導権を得るか）を設定し、一貫した試合の流れを強制する。

CUT LOGIC で編集を制御する：接触時、または位置変化によりより明確なアングルが必要な場合のみカットし、それ以外は連続したアクションを維持する。

タイムスタンプ付きのビート（例：0.0–3.0 pressure、3.0–6.0 first attack、6.0–9.5 counter、9.5–12.5 reversal、12.5–15.0 finish）で生成をストーリーボード化し、各セグメントごとにカメラとアクションを定義する。

各ビートについて、撮影の指示としてショットのスケール、角度、物理的な位置、動き（およびカットが連続か、動機づけられたものか）を指定する。

AUDIO セクションを追加し（音楽なし、グローブ／身体への打撃、キャンバス上を滑る足音、呼吸、ロープの張力、コーナーの反応、遠くの観客のざわめき）、サウンドデザインを誘導する。

NEGATIVE CONTROL ブロックを含め、一般的な失敗モード（ランダムな攻撃、浮いたようなフットワーク、接触していないのにヒットとして見せる、テレポート、踏み込みのない構え変更、画面方向の逆転、役割の入れ替わり、顔の変形、追加ファイター、コメディ、字幕、ロゴ、UI）を禁止する。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Prompt template

[FORMAT / START]
[duration] [aspect ratio] のシネマティックな実写ムエタイの試合を生成する。アクションは即座に始まる。アップロードされた画像を、キャラクターのハードリファレンスとして使用する。

[CHARACTER LOCK]
Image A is Fighter A. Preserve exact face, hair, build, shorts, gloves, and silhouette.
Image B is Fighter B. Preserve exact face, hair, build, shorts, gloves, and silhouette.
Do not swap fighters. No extras inside the ring.

[SPACE LOCK]
Fighter A starts [position] in [stance].
Fighter B starts [position] in [stance].
Keep the ropes, corners, center mark, and left-right relationship consistent. Show every change of position.

[SETTING]
Professional Muay Thai ring under hard overhead arena lights. Dark audience beyond the ropes. Canvas sweat, corner posts, and taut ropes.

[COMBAT RULES]
Use realistic guard, distance, footwork, weight transfer, contact, and recovery. Every strike has a visible setup. Every defense creates the next opening. Fighters return to guard after contact. No impossible combinations.

DRAMATIC ENGINE: Combat
SCENE TURN: [Fighter] gains control by [decisive action].
CUT LOGIC: Cut only when contact or a position change requires a clearer angle.

[0.0–3.0 — PRESSURE]

Camera: [shot scale, angle, physical position, movement].

Action: Fighter A [advances/circles/cuts off the ring]. Fighter B watches A’s chest, adjusts the guard, and retreats toward [ropes/corner].

[3.0–6.0 — FIRST ATTACK]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A plants [foot] and throws [strike]. Fighter B [blocks/checks/parries], absorbs the contact, and shifts to [new position].

[6.0–9.5 — COUNTER]

Camera: [shot scale and collision angle].

Action: Fighter B reads the opening, steps [inside/outside], and counters with [strike]. Fighter A’s head or body reacts on contact before the guard recovers.

[9.5–12.5 — REVERSAL]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A regains balance, meets B’s eyes, and [pivots/closes distance/enters the clinch]. B braces and fights for position.

[12.5–15.0 — FINISH]

Camera: [clear final angle]. Hold through the impact.

Action: [Fighter] controls [head/arm/ring position], creates space, and lands [finishing strike]. The opponent hits [ropes/canvas] while the winner resets the guard and watches them.

[AUDIO]
No music. Gloves striking guard and body, bare feet sliding on canvas, controlled breathing, rope tension, corner reactions, and distant crowd noise.

[NEGATIVE CONTROL]
No random attacks, no floating footwork, no missed contact shown as impact, no teleporting, no stance switching without visible steps, no crossed screen direction, no role swap, no face morphing, no extra fighters, no comedy, no subtitles, no logos, no UI.

ko.content:
업로드한 이미지를 강력한 캐릭터 레퍼런스로 사용하고, 각 이미지를 특정 파이터에 명확히 고정하여 얼굴/의상/실루엣 드리프트와 역할 바뀜을 방지한다.

Seedance가 정확한 얼굴, 머리카락, 체형, 반바지, 글러브, 실루엣을 그대로 유지하도록 지시하고, 파이터를 서로 바꾸거나 추가 인물을 넣는 것을 금지하는 CHARACTER LOCK 섹션을 추가한다.

각 파이터의 시작 위치와 자세를 고정하고, 로프/코너/센터 마크와 좌우 관계를 일관되게 유지하면서 모든 위치 변화를 보여주도록 모델에 지시하는 SPACE LOCK 섹션을 추가한다.

장면 설정을 안정화하기 위해 조명과 환경 세부사항(강한 상부 아레나 조명, 로프 너머의 어두운 관중석, 캔버스 위의 땀, 팽팽한 로프, 코너 포스트)을 명시한다.

명시적인 COMBAT RULES(현실적인 가드/거리/풋워크/체중 이동/접촉/회복; 모든 타격 전 보이는 준비 동작; 가드 복귀; 불가능한 콤비네이션 금지)로 동작의 사실성을 제한한다.

DRAMATIC ENGINE를 사용한다: Combat directive와 SCENE TURN(누가 어떤 결정적인 행동으로 주도권을 잡는지)을 결합해 일관된 경기 서사를 강제한다.

CUT LOGIC으로 편집을 제어한다: 접촉 순간이나 더 명확한 앵글이 필요한 위치 변화가 있을 때만 컷하고, 그 외에는 연속 동작을 유지한다.

타임스탬프가 있는 비트(예: 0.0–3.0 압박, 3.0–6.0 첫 공격, 6.0–9.5 카운터, 9.5–12.5 반전, 12.5–15.0 피니시)로 스토리보드를 구성하고, 각 구간별 카메라와 액션을 정의한다.

각 비트마다 촬영 스케일, 앵글, 물리적 위치, 움직임(그리고 컷이 연속인지, 동기 부여된 컷인지 여부)을 지정해 촬영 구성을 안내한다.

사운드 디자인을 유도하기 위해 AUDIO 섹션(음악 없음; 글러브/신체 충돌음, 캔버스 위 발 미끄러짐, 호흡, 로프의 장력, 코너 반응, 멀리서 들리는 관중 소리)을 추가한다.

흔한 실패 모드(무작위 공격, 떠 있는 듯한 풋워크, 빗나간 접촉을 타격처럼 보여주기, 순간이동, 발을 딛지 않은 자세 전환, 화면 방향 교차, 역할 바뀜, 얼굴 변형, 추가 파이터, 코미디, 자막, 로고, UI)를 금지하는 NEGATIVE CONTROL 블록을 포함한다.

pt.content:
Use imagens enviadas como referências rígidas de personagem e trave explicitamente cada imagem a um lutador específico para evitar deriva de rosto/roupa/silhueta e troca de papéis.

Adicione uma seção CHARACTER LOCK que instrua o Seedance a preservar exatamente rosto, cabelo, porte físico, shorts, luvas e silhueta, e a proibir a troca de lutadores ou a inclusão de extras.

Adicione uma seção SPACE LOCK que fixe a posição inicial e a postura de cada lutador, e instrua o modelo a manter cordas/cantos/marca central e a relação esquerda-direita consistentes, mostrando cada mudança de posição.

Especifique os detalhes de iluminação e ambiente (luzes fortes de arena vindas de cima, público escuro além das cordas, suor no canvas, cordas tensionadas, postes de canto) para estabilizar o cenário.

Restrinja o realismo do movimento com COMBAT RULES explícitas (guarda/distância/footwork/transferência de peso/contato/recuperação realistas; preparação visível para cada golpe; retorno à guarda; sem combinações impossíveis).

Use um DRAMATIC ENGINE: diretiva de combate + SCENE TURN (quem ganha controle e por qual ação decisiva) para forçar um arco de luta coerente.

Controle as edições com CUT LOGIC: corte apenas no contato ou quando uma mudança de posição exigir um ângulo mais claro; caso contrário, mantenha a ação contínua.

Estruture o storyboard da geração com beats cronometrados (por exemplo, 0.0–3.0 pressão, 3.0–6.0 primeiro ataque, 6.0–9.5 contra-ataque, 9.5–12.5 reversão, 12.5–15.0 finalização) e defina câmera + ação para cada segmento.

Para cada beat, especifique a escala do enquadramento, o ângulo, a posição física e o movimento da câmera (e se o corte é contínuo ou motivado) para orientar a cinematografia.

Adicione uma seção AUDIO (sem música; luvas/corpo impactando, pés deslizando no canvas, respiração, tensão das cordas, reações do corner, público ao fundo) para direcionar o design de som.

Inclua um bloco NEGATIVE CONTROL proibindo modos comuns de falha (ataques aleatórios, footwork flutuante, impacto mostrado sem contato, teletransporte, trocas de postura sem passo visível, direção de tela cruzada, troca de papéis, morphing de rosto, lutadores extras, comédia, legendas, logos, UI).

[Thread 1] Prompt template

[FORMAT / START]
Generate a [duration] [aspect ratio] cinematic live-action Muay Thai fight. Action begins immediately. Use the uploaded images as hard character references.

[CHARACTER LOCK]
Image A is Fighter A. Preserve exact face, hair, build, shorts, gloves, and silhouette.
Image B is Fighter B. Preserve exact face, hair, build, shorts, gloves, and silhouette.
Do not swap fighters. No extras inside the ring.

[SPACE LOCK]
Fighter A starts [position] in [stance].
Fighter B starts [position] in [stance].
Keep the ropes, corners, center mark, and left-right relationship consistent. Show every change of position.

[SETTING]
Professional Muay Thai ring under hard overhead arena lights. Dark audience beyond the ropes. Canvas sweat, corner posts, and taut ropes.

[COMBAT RULES]
Use realistic guard, distance, footwork, weight transfer, contact, and recovery. Every strike has a visible setup. Every defense creates the next opening. Fighters return to guard after contact. No impossible combinations.

DRAMATIC ENGINE: Combat
SCENE TURN: [Fighter] gains control by [decisive action].
CUT LOGIC: Cut only when contact or a position change requires a clearer angle.

[0.0–3.0 — PRESSURE]

Camera: [shot scale, angle, physical position, movement].

Action: Fighter A [advances/circles/cuts off the ring]. Fighter B watches A’s chest, adjusts the guard, and retreats toward [ropes/corner].

[3.0–6.0 — FIRST ATTACK]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A plants [foot] and throws [strike]. Fighter B [blocks/checks/parries], absorbs the contact, and shifts to [new position].

[6.0–9.5 — COUNTER]

Camera: [shot scale and collision angle].

Action: Fighter B reads the opening, steps [inside/outside], and counters with [strike]. Fighter A’s head or body reacts on contact before the guard recovers.

[9.5–12.5 — REVERSAL]

Camera: [continuous or motivated cut].

Action: Fighter A regains balance, meets B’s eyes, and [pivots/closes distance/enters the clinch]. B braces and fights for position.

[12.5–15.0 — FINISH]

Camera: [clear final angle]. Hold through the impact.

Action: [Fighter] controls [head/arm/ring position], creates space, and lands [finishing strike]. The opponent hits [ropes/canvas] while the winner resets the guard and watches them.

[AUDIO]
No music. Gloves striking guard and body, bare feet sliding on canvas, controlled breathing, rope tension, corner reactions, and distant crowd noise.

[NEGATIVE CONTROL]
No random attacks, no floating footwork, no missed contact shown as impact, no teleporting, no stance switching without visible steps, no crossed screen direction, no role swap, no face morphing, no extra fighters, no comedy, no subtitles, no logos, no UI.

zh.content:
使用上传的图片作为硬性角色参考，并将每张图片明确锁定到特定拳手，以防止面部/服装/轮廓漂移和角色互换。

添加一个 CHARACTER LOCK 部分，指示 Seedance 保持面部、发型、体型、短裤、手套和轮廓完全一致，并禁止拳手互换或加入额外人物。

添加一个 SPACE LOCK 部分，固定每位拳手的起始位置和站姿，并指示模型在展示每次位置变化时，保持绳索/角落/中心标记以及左右关系一致。

指定光照和环境细节（拳馆硬质顶灯、绳索外的昏暗观众区、画布上的汗水、绷紧的绳索、角柱），以稳定场景设定。

用明确的 COMBAT RULES 约束动作真实性（真实的防守/距离/步法/重心转移/接触/恢复；每次出拳/出腿都要有清晰的准备动作；回到防守姿势；不允许不可能的组合）。

使用 DRAMATIC ENGINE：Combat directive 加上 SCENE TURN（谁通过什么决定性动作取得控制）来强制形成连贯的战斗弧线。

用 CUT LOGIC 控制剪辑：只在接触点或位置变化需要更清晰角度时切镜；否则保持连续动作。

用带时间戳的节拍来设计分镜（例如 0.0–3.0 压迫，3.0–6.0 首次进攻，6.0–9.5 反击，9.5–12.5 逆转，12.5–15.0 终结），并为每个片段定义镜头与动作。

对于每个节拍，指定镜头景别、角度、物理位置和运动方式（以及切镜是连续还是有动机的），以指导摄影语言。

添加一个 AUDIO 部分（无音乐；手套/身体撞击声、脚在画布上滑动声、呼吸声、绳索张力声、角落反应声、远处观众声）来引导声音设计。

加入一个 NEGATIVE CONTROL 模块，禁止常见失败模式（随机攻击、漂浮式步法、把未命中的动作表现成命中、瞬移、未踏步的站姿切换、屏幕方向交叉、角色互换、面部变形、额外拳手、喜剧效果、字幕、logo、UI）。
